title: Tiny, cute avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under avocado -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#2a4a2a'/>
  <!-- avocado outer skin -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='34' fill='#4a8a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='23' ry='31' fill='#5aa84a'/>
  <!-- avocado flesh -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='18' ry='26' fill='#c8e86a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='16' ry='24' fill='#d8f07a'/>
  <!-- pit -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='9' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='59' r='3' fill='#a87038'/>
  <!-- cute eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='42' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#2a4a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='42' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#2a4a2a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='49' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='49' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 49 Q50 54 55 49' stroke='#2a4a2a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little arms -->
  <path d='M26 50 Q20 46 18 42' stroke='#4a8a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 50 Q80 46 82 42' stroke='#4a8a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#4a8a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#4a8a3a'/>
</svg>
